ops.title: ccx GitHub viewer lookup must stay repo-scope only
ops.body: vcs.LookupRepo once asked viewer.organizations, and GitHub refuses that field's login for a classic token with only the repo scope (INSUFFICIENT_SCOPES). The ai-oncall retro job's poetic-svc token failed in ship as a result. Since #366 (v0.77.13) fetchViewer asks viewer{login} and repositoryOwner(login:$owner){... on Organization{viewerIsAMember}}, both readable with repo scope. The goldens viewer-graphql-repo-scope and repo-view-repo-scope are recorded with GH_REPO_SCOPE_TOKEN, so changing the query means re-recording it under a repo-only token.
